items.title: History Class Brewing Company
items.html:
Website: https://www.historyclass.beer

Phone: (850) 801-2337

Address: 6 E. 4th Street, Panama City, FL 32401

Just a short drive from the beach, this cozy brewpub is part community hub, part museum—celebrating Bay County’s history one craft beer at a time. Whether you're sipping the floral Singing Sisters Saison or enjoying The Hero porter, you're part of a narrative.

Hours: Wed–Thu: 4–10 PM | Fri–Sat: 11 AM–10 PM | Sun: 11 AM–8 PM | Closed Mon–Tue

Why Visit: Community donations, locally inspired brews, historic décor, kid- and dog-friendly vibes

Plan Ahead: No reservation needed unless your group is 6+; walk-ins typically welcome.

items.title: Idyll Hounds Brewing Company
items.html:
Website: https://www.idyllhoundsbrewingcompany.com

Phone: (850) 231-1138

Just a short drive from your stay, discover this inviting brewery nestled in Santa Rosa Beach. With a focus on creative, locally inspired beers and a warm, warehouse-style taproom, it’s perfect for a relaxed evening or casual meet-up. Whether you're curious about their rotating brews or just ready to kick back with good company, Idyll Hounds has you covered.

Hours: Mon–Tue 12–7 PM | Wed–Thu 12–8 PM | Fri–Sat 11 AM–9 PM | Sun 12–7 PM

items.title: The Craft Bar – Gastropub Style at Pier Park North
items.html:
Website: https://www.thecraftbarfl.com/panama-city-beach The Craft Bar

Phone: (850) 588-7309

Located right inside Pier Park North, this upscale gastropub offers a killer mix of craft beer, cocktails, and inventive dishes—all made from scratch with care. Whether you're craving a gourmet burger, craving a rare beer on tap, or just want a fun evening out, this is the place.

What’s Great: 30+ craft beers, creative cocktails, chef-driven menu
Weekly Highlights: Burger Night (Mon), Trivia (Tue), Happy Hour specials

A smart pick for both families and craft beer lovers—perfect for a breezy dinner or casual night out. Interested in a curated “beer crawl” route including this and other favorites? Just say the word!

items.title: The Craft Beer Empourium
items.html:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CraftBeerEmPOURium

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/craftbeerempourium

Phone: (850) 785-1166

Just a short drive from the beach, this iconic downtown spot brings together billiards and craft beer in one unforgettable experience. With more than 300 brews on offer—ranging from IPAs to stouts, ciders, and wine—it’s the perfect hangout whether you're flying solo or in a group.

What to Expect: Massive beer selection, pool tables, a laid-back vibe, and late-night service.
Perks: Smoke-free, pet-friendly, and a community hub for beer lovers and game aficionados alike.

items.title: Panama City Beach Winery
items.html:
A local community staple, the Panama City Beach Winery offers the best 100% real fruit wines. Join a wine tasting to sample incredible choices like Mango, Kiwi, and Guava. Sip the 'Fresh from Florida' wine on a nice evening out and let the Sunshine State dance on your palate. 

 

https://panamacitybeachwinery.com/
(850) 233-5950

items.title: Duplin Winery
items.html:
Warm, Southern hospitality greets you the minute you walk in the door. The Duplin family will welcome you with open arms. Enjoy a wine tasting with our knowledgeable and friendly guides. Sit on the porch with your favorite Duplin wine and listen to live music. Take a tour to see our hand bottling as we did it when we started. Parooze the gift shop to buy loved ones from home some wine or accessories.

 

https://www.duplinwinery.com/visit-us#panama-city-beach
(910) 289-3888

items.title: Andy's Flour Power
items.html:
A must-try voted Best Brunch on the Best of Bay list, and featured in Southern Living Magazine! Andy's Flour Power provides breakfast and bakery delicacies, baking the freshest ingredients. A go-to while in Panama City Beach! 

 

https://www.andysflourpower.com/
(850) 230-0014

items.title: Sunrise Cafe & Bakery
items.html:
Family-owned and operated serving breakfast and lunch all day! Grab a fresh donut or croissant, or if you're stopping by to grab a cold treat, ice creams, gelatos, milkshakes are bound to cool you down on that hot summer day! 

 

https://sunrisecafebakery.com/
850-588-6795

items.title: Thomas Donut & Snack Shop
items.html:
Thomas Donut & Snack Shop is the perfect place to stop for a snack on vacation. Tourists and locals alike frequent Thomas Donut & Snack Shop for their great atmosphere, great food, and all around great experience. Whether you’re looking for a good breakfast or something to satisfy your sweet tooth, Thomas Donut & Snack shop has what you need.

 

http://www.thomasdonutandsnackshop.com/
850-234-8039

items.title: Harpoon Harry's
items.html:
Harpoon Harry's sits on the beach, so you can grab some seafood grub and enjoy immaculate views of the Gulf of Mexico! Whether it's lunch or dinner, Harpoon Harry's is the perfect spot for great food and awesome views. When you come to visit, ask for the famous Giant Seafood bucket and or one of the 42 oz Monster drinks! 

 

https://harpoonharry.com/
(850) 234-6060

items.title: Local Steamer Seafood Market
items.html:
You can't miss the Local Steamer Seafood Market. This beloved local staple has made it to the top of every food list and for good reason, there's just nothing that compares to fresh, local seafood! No matter what you order here, whether the world-famous tuna dip, enormous snow crab, the 5 star seafood platter, you know you're in for a finger-licking good time.

 

https://www.seafoodmarketpcb.com/
(850) 866-9330

items.title: Pineapple Willy's
items.html:
A must-try while in Panama City Beach, Pineapple Willy's is an on-the-sand local favorite known for their amazing seafood and grill. Whether you opt to lounge on the share with a plate of their world-famous BBQ ribs, sip on cool daiquiris or go on into the evening to jive to the live music, Pineapple Willy's will definitely be one of your favorite stops during your trip.

 

https://pwillys.com/
(850) 235-0928

items.title: Sharky's Beachfront Restaurant
items.html:
Sharky's is the perfect place to go for a quick lunch with the entire family. This on-the-beach restaurant is complete with a pirate ship playground, so the kids can make new friends and play while you kick back, sip on a cool one, and relax! A tiki bar-themed restaurant, you'll get great seafood, live entertainment, a full bar, and amazing views! 

 

https://sharkysbeach.com/
(850) 235-2420

items.title: Bayou on the Beach
items.html:
This New Orleans-style family restaurant is known for its authentic Cajun cuisine, to-die-for raw oysters, good music, and a great time! Whether you want to come around for the oyster bar, the world-famous shrimp grits or treat your little ones to something from the kids menu, Bayou on the Beach will promise to be a satisfying night out for the entire family. 

 

https://www.bayouonthebeachcafe.com/
(850) 249-3478

items.title: Capt. Anderson's
items.html:
This wonderful family-owned restaurant is known as one of the best seafood restaurants in the area and has won many awards to show for it, on top of being inducted into the Restaurant Hall of Fame. How often can you say that you've had literal award-winning seafood? 

 

https://www.captandersons.com/
(850) 234-2225

items.title: Dat Cajun Place
items.html:
If you're looking for creole, Dat Cajun Place has to be at the top of your list of restaurants to visit! A highly reviewed restaurant having won 3 Best of Bay awards in 2022, including Best Oysters, Best Meal for your Money, and Best New Restaurant in Bay County! With food this good, one visit probably won't be enough! 

 

https://datcajunplace.com/
(850) 588-5314

items.title: Schooners
items.html:
A laid-back waterfront beach club that will be perfect for you to grab some drinks while you're on the way home from a big day at St. Andrew's Skate Park! Schooners provides a diverse food menu, a large craft beer menu, a great wine menu, and a list of specialty drinks that promises a great evening of drinks, dinner and live music while enjoying great views of the ocean! 


https://www.schooners.com/
(850) 235-3555

items.title: Wicked Wheel
items.html:
A sister company to Pineapple Willy's but with a completely different vibe altogether, the Wicked Wheel is known for being a hot-rod-themed restaurant and for its amazing southern food. Chow down on some award-winning fried chicken, snap some pics of some custom hot-rod cars, or sit on a motorcycle at the bar (that's right, on a motorcycle) while throwing back a beer or two. The Wicked Wheel is bound to be one for the memory books! 

 

https://thewickedwheel.com/
(850) 588-4947

items.title: A Taste of Panama City Food Tours
items.html:
Website: https://atasteofpanamacityfoodtours.com/ 

Phone: (850) 867-8552

These guided walking tours—like the Harrison Avenue or Beck Avenue Food Tours—offer bites from local favorites while weaving in stories of Panama City Beach’s culture and history. It’s a perfect combo of savory sampling and sightseeing for food-loving explorers.

items.title: Boozy Bites or Themed Food Tours
items.html:
Website: https://atasteofpanamacityfoodtours.com/boozy-bites

Details via: A Taste of Panama City Food Tours

For visitors seeking a spirited spin, their “Boozy Bites” or themed outings pair local sips with bites at curated stops—perfect for those looking to combine tasting and tippling in a fun, guided format.

items.title: Shell Island
items.html:
Runs from Panama City Beach (via Adventures at Sea or St. Andrews State Park) on a seasonal schedule—typically every 30 minutes during summer. Adults ~$24.95; kids 2–12 ~$17.95; infants free. Boats allow coolers and beach gear onboard. Visit Panama City Beach

https://www.visitpanamacitybeach.com/things-to-do/fishing-charters/ 

Boat & Jet Ski Rentals
Ideal for independent visits. Many rentals include pontoons, kayaks, paddleboards, or jet skis—perfect for accessing secluded sandbars at your own pace. Beach Shell Island Shuttle

Guided Tours & Dolphin Cruises
Explore via boat with dolphin snorkel excursions, narrated tours, or eco-cruises. Options include Adventures at Sea, Flippers Dolphin Tours, Capt. Anderson’s Marina, and others.

Adventures at Sea Tours & Rentals

items.title: Russell-Fields City Pier
items.html:
Just across from Pier Park, this iconic pier stretches more than 1,500 feet into the Gulf. It’s open 24/7, 365 days a year—perfect for fishing at dawn, sunset walks, or spotting marine life from the rails.

Address: 16201 Front Beach Road, Panama City Beach, FL 32413, directly across from Pier Park’s main entrance Panama City Beach

Visit Panama City Beach.

Phone: (850) 233-5080

Website: City information is available via the City of Panama City Beach Parks & Recreation department

Fees: Fishing $7/day, spectators $4; discounts for seniors, military, and children under 6. Multi-day and annual passes available.
What You Can Do Here: Bring your own rod or rent one on-site. Look for dolphins, manatees, stingrays—sunrise and sunset are especially enchanting.
Nearby: Walk across to Pier Park for shops, restaurants, and family fun like mini-golf and the skywheel—great for combining relaxation with adventure.

Pier Park: Just across the street—packed with dining, shopping, entertainment like theaters, mini-golf, and the PCB Ferris Wheel

Gear & Bait: On-site rod rentals, plus bait, tackle, and license sales available at the pier entrance

items.title: Legacy Golf Club
items.html:
Hit the beach then hit the links at the Legacy Golf Club.

A championship course with challenging greens designed to test golfers with even the sharpest short-game skills. The fairways are generously sized with lakes and white sand bunkers that fiercely guard the elevated greens. Players should be prepared to use every club in their bag! The best way to relax and spend a little me or we time while on your holiday.

 

https://www.legacygolfpcb.com/
(850) 234-1800

items.title: Nicklaus Course at Bay Point Golf Club
items.html: The only Nicklaus Design course in Northwest Florida, situated in a nature preserve and minutes from the beach, offering unique water hazards and sand traps carved from natural Floridian terrain.

items.title: Signal Hill
items.html:
http://www.signalhillgolfcourse.com/

The oldest golf course in Panama City Beach, offering 5,617 yards of golf from the longest tees, with challenging greens and precise fairways, making it a relaxed, reliable community course.

items.title: CVS Pharmacy – Target at Pier Park
items.html:
Website: https://www.target.com/sl/pier-park/2208
Phone: (850) 236-3720 (Target main line)
Address: Inside Target, 15555 Starfish St, Panama City Beach, FL 32413

This CVS is conveniently located inside Target at Pier Park, making it a smart stop for prescriptions, toiletries, and last-minute essentials while shopping or dining. With standard pharmacy hours, it’s ideal when you need to combine errands and restocking.

items.title: Walmart Supercenter
items.html:
Website: https://www.walmart.com/store/3119-panama-city%20beach-fl
Phone: (850) 708-6968
Location: 15495 Panama City Beach Pkwy, Panama City Beach, FL 32413

A convenient, all-in-one option offering groceries, beach supplies, household essentials, and more. With extended hours, it’s a smart choice for families or anyone looking to restock quickly and affordably.

items.title: Grocery Delivery Service
items.html:
Would you like a fully stocked fridge waiting for you upon arrival? Vacation is supposed to be relaxing, and the last thing you should worry about is heading to the store on a supply run, during heavy traffic. We can make sure all your groceries are delivered beforehand.

Pre-purchase an order online at one of the local stores and our partner Denise will deliver and store the food for you prior to your arrival! 

Reach out to Megan with Megan Curtis Concierge at 660-605-2321 to coordinate ahead of time.

items.title: Conservation Park
items.html:
A favorite destination for locals and visitors alike, Conservation Park is a great place to spend a little time in the great outdoors. Conservation Park has 12 different walking trails to choose from, ranging anywhere from 0.6 miles to 11 miles per trail. After a long walk, you can opt to rent one of the picnic tables and spend lunch eating amongst lush greenery and loved ones. 

(850) 233-5045

items.title: Shell Island
items.html:
While you're at St. Andrew's State Park, hop on over to Shell Island, where unspoiled beaches provide a serene escape, ideal for relaxation and beachcombing. 

A 7-mile long barrier island, this undeveloped stretch of white sand beach, coastal scrubland, and pine hammocks separate St. Andrews Bay from the open waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Shell Island is a haven for wildlife, marine animals, and beach lovers looking for a day in a pristine natural setting away from the resorts and condominiums that line the beach to the north.

You will need to book a Ferry to Shell Island, which you can do directly from the park's website in advance or at the Pier Store (follow signs from the entrance gate). 

https://standrewsshellisland.com/shell-island-ferry/
844-907-4355

items.title: St. Andrews State Park
items.html:
Discover the ultimate outdoor paradise at St. Andrews State Park and Shell Island in Panama City Beach, Florida. This breathtaking destination is perfect for beach lovers and nature enthusiasts alike. Offering a pristine coastal landscape, St. Andrews State Park is a haven for swimming, snorkeling, and exploring diverse wildlife.

https://standrewsshellisland.com/
(844) 907-4355

items.title: Axe Throwing PCB
items.html:
Unless you hate fun, you’ll love your visit to Axe Throwing PCB.

No need to mope around and miss out on fun when the weather is bad … with indoor facilities and a new outdoor venue, you’ll be comfortable throwing an axe, rain or shine.

Axe throwing has become a favorite activity for all. Fun, laughs and a bit fo healthy exercise makes this a perfect afternoon activity for pairs or groups, regardless of skill level. If you're a beginner, you will be guided by helpful employees, so all can learn how to accurately throw an axe at the target and aim for that bullseye! 

 

https://axethrowingpcb.com/
+18502494790

items.title: Dave & Buster's
items.html:
Dave & Buster's is the ONLY place to eat, drink, play, and watch sports all under one roof! Great for both kids and kids at heart, spend the day playing games, watching sports, chowing down on some great food, and making memories! 

 

(850) 238-3501

items.title: Royal Escape Rooms
items.html:
Immerse yourself in one of our thrilling escape game room stories and take on the challenge of discovering clues and unlocking puzzles to try to escape. It's up to you to find the solutions – leaving the fate of escaping in your hands! come and Have fun with your family and friends!

 

https://www.royalescaperooms.com/
(850) 249-2805

items.title: SkyWheel
items.html:
SkyWheel Panama City Beach is a full entertainment venue featuring an 18-hole mini golf course and the SkyWheel, an observation wheel that stands nearly 200 ft. tall. SkyWheel is open all year long and promises an unforgettable, unique experience for children and adults of all ages.

 

https://skywheelpcb.com/
(850) 888-0020

items.title: Crushed Glass Art Studio
items.html:
Try something new while you're in town! Join a glass art or resin art class with your friends or loved ones and bring home a unique souvenir! You will be guided throughout the entire process, so don't worry about your skill level, all can join! Create unique resin charcuterie boards or unique glass canvases, all while creating beautiful memories while doing this unique activity! 

 

https://www.crushedpcb.com/
(850) 238-2526

items.title: Ripley's Believe It or Not!
items.html:
Ripley's Believe It or Not! is one of the Gulf Coast's favorite indoor attractions. Experience the fun and unique exhibits ranging from a floating wooden fiat, learning about the famous Titanic shipwreck, and seeing your favorite star's portrait done in the most unique ways. Strap on your seat belts for the seriously realistic 7D Moving Theater experience.  The state-of-the-art theater with digital effects and motion seats will have you feeling like you're in the movie! 

 

https://www.ripleys.com/attractions/ripleys-believe-it-or-not-panama-city-beach
(850) 230-6113

items.title: Sea Dragon Pirate Cruise
items.html:
Enjoy an exciting and scenic 2-hour family Pirate activity cruise that includes dolphin sightings, great music, and non-stop pirate activities for the kids. Cold beer, soda, snacks, t-shirts & pirate souvenirs are available on board as well as clean restrooms. Located on Grand Lagoon in the Lighthouse Marina next to the Grand Marlin Restaurant. Open March through October!
 
https://www.piratecruise.net/
(850) 234-7400

items.title: Shipwreck Island Waterpark
items.html:
Plunge, ride, whirl, dunk, swim - whew! Spend the day trying out all the slides, ride on a zipline from a shipwreck into the water, bob around in a wave pool, relax in a lazy river and don't forget to be grabbing that ice cream or slushie in the middle of it all! With over 15 acres dedicated to this waterpark, you're guaranteed to have a great full day! 

 

https://www.shipwreckisland.com/
(850) 234-3333

items.title: Swampy Jack's Wongo Adventure
items.html:
Go-karts, miniature golf, and much more!

Swampy Jack’s Wongo Adventure is a hybrid amusement park and family entertainment center. A small, but heavily themed park highlights Swampy Jack’s world travels. Experience a unique go-kart experience, think Mario Kart video game meets electric go-karts on the interactive outdoor go-kart track of our Marrakesh Road Rally. If go-karts are not your thing, the miniature golf is scenic in the day time, funky with neon at night, and fun all the time. Then, you'll have to tie it all together with the rides, from bumper cars, to spin coasters to spooky labyrinths! 

 

https://wongoadventure.com/
(850) 234 - 9973

items.title: WonderWorks
items.html:
WonderWorks is an indoor amusement park combining education and entertainment in over 100 hands-on exhibits that will spark the imagination and challenge the mind. Interactive, educational, and fun for all ages! Those visiting the attraction will enjoy a variety of experiences including being blown away by hurricane-force winds, maneuvering the controls of a NASA spacecraft to land the shuttle, lying on a bed of 3,500 nails, piloting a fighter jet, riding a 360-degree roller coaster, carrying out intense military missions in the Black Hawk Experience and competing in a game of laser tag.

 

https://www.wonderworksonline.com/panama-city-beach/
(850) 249-7000

items.title: ZooWorld Zoological Park
items.html:
Take a breach from the beach and create lasting family memories at the ZooWorld Zoological Park! Home to exotic animals from all over the world. Pet a sloth, kiss a kangaroo, feed a giraffe, meet a lemur or, if you dare, pet a porcupine! 
 
This place is wilder than the beach at spring break! 
 
https://zooworldpcb.com/
850-600-8866

items.title: Coconut Creek Family Fun Park
items.html:
Fun and adventure for the whole family! Come experience the excitement and challenge of playing Coconut Creek's two tropical 18-hole mini-golf courses and NEW sea-themed 18-hole mini-golf course. Then come aboard and get lost in the awesome Gran Maze, a giant-size human maze.
 
https://coconutcreekfun.com/
(850) 234-2625

items.title: Rock'it Lanes
items.html:
Wholesome family fun for everyone! 

A family fun center where you'll have everything you could possibly need to have fun with the entire family! Whether you want to come for a night of bowling, rollerskating, having fun at the mega arcadae, watching a game at the sports bar or just having a bite to eat at the great grille, this family fun center has you covered!

 

https://rockitlanes.com/
(850) 249-2695

items.title: Slingshot & Vomatron
items.html:
A mini amusement park complete with the Slingshot, the Vomatron, and go-karts! 
 
On the SlingShot, get catapulted 300 feet into the air, reaching 0- 100mph in less than 2 seconds before freefalling back towards the ground. Because there is no age limit, just a minimum height limit of 50 inches, you and your little adrenaline junkie can go and experience an exhilarating night! 
 
The Vomatron is best described as a 200-foot giant propeller, similar to what NASA used to train astronauts for space flight. Be rotated at speeds up to 70mph and experience 4Gs! As if that wasn't enough, you'll be spun going backwards as well. Similarly, there isn't an age limit, just a height limit of 50 inches, so grab your little astronaut and get those Gs!
 
If you were looking for something closer to the ground but still looking for that speed, zip around the track on the fastest go-karts on the beach! 
 

https://slingshotpcb.com/
(850) 234-1121

items.title: Pier Park
items.html:
Website: https://www.visitpanamacitybeach.com/pier-park/

https://www.visitpanamacitybeach.com/pier-park/stores/ 
Phone: Typically via Simon Property Group customer service

The area's premier open-air lifestyle center, featuring over 140 stores including big anchors like Target, Dillard’s, JCPenney—and fashion favorites like Old Navy, American Eagle, and Forever 21 (the latter closed early 2025). You’ll also find a wide range of dining options, an IMAX movie theater, arcade games, a 200-ft Skywheel, laser tag, and family attractions.

items.title: The Shoppes at Edgewater
items.html:
Website: Sun & Sand Rentals
Location: Inside Edgewater Beach & Golf Resort area
Phone: Likely available via resort

A collection of charming boutique stores offering jewelry, beachwear, and home décor—perfect for resort guests who prefer convenience and local flair.

items.title: 30Avenue
items.html:
Website: https://www.thirtyavenue.com/ 
Phone: Available through retail directory
Location: Inlet Beach, near Panama City Beach

A stylish, upscale shopping destination with trendy boutiques, art galleries, and gourmet dining options. A delightful short drive for premium finds. If you're looking for a more upscale shopping experience, visit 30Avenue. Located in nearby Inlet Beach, this shopping center features high-end boutiques, art galleries, and gourmet restaurants. Some of our personal favorites include Willow + Mercer, which offers trendy clothing and accessories, and Amici Italian Kitchen, which serves delicious italian cuisine and wines.

items.title: Serenity Spa at Bluegreen Bayside Resort
items.html:
Website: https://www.bluegreenbaysideresort.com/Experiences/serenity-spa.html

Phone: (850) 236-6000 / (855) 481-8275 / (855) 481-8276

An award-winning full-service spa offering massage therapies, revitalizing facials, pedicures, and salon services within a relaxing resort setting. On-site amenities include sauna, steam room, whirlpool, and a quiet relaxation lounge. Day passes are available for full access. Perfect for a luxurious, all-in-one experience where you can unwind fully. Ideal after beach days or as part of a romantic getaway.

items.title: Salon Baliage & Spa
items.html:
Website:  https://salonbaliage.com/

Salon: 104 Carillon Market Street, Suite 1, same complex.

Phone: Spa: (850) 235-1985 | Salon: (850) 235-1980

A combined salon and spa with 25+ years of local presence, offering services like haircuts, coloring, waxing, massages, body treatments, skin care, and packages. Located in the charming Carillon Beach Resort area. Offers both beauty and spa in a scenic, quaint resort village—perfect for stylish guests seeking convenience and comprehensive services.

items.title: Panama City Beach
items.html:
For the most up-to-date weather forecast check here!

Remember, the weather person is the only one who can be wrong and still keep their job. We like to say "There is no such thing as bad weather, just inappropriate clothing".
